simpleProperties.name: invoiceNumber
simpleProperties.description: The invoice, receipt, or bill number as printed on the document. Leave empty if the document has none.

simpleProperties.name: invoiceDate
simpleProperties.description: The date on the document (issue date or billing date). Format is yyyy-mm-dd. Leave empty if no date is present.

simpleProperties.name: vendorName
simpleProperties.description: The vendor, supplier, or biller the document is from. Use 'Unknown' if it cannot be determined.

simpleProperties.name: amountDue
simpleProperties.description: The total amount owed or billed, as shown on the document. Leave empty if there's no payable amount.

simpleProperties.name: currency
simpleProperties.description: The currency the amount is stated in (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Leave empty if not indicated.

simpleProperties.name: extractionStatus
simpleProperties.description: 1='Full' if every relevant figure was read with confidence; 2='Partial' if any part of the document was unreadable, ambiguous, or required inference.

simpleProperties.name: transformationNote
simpleProperties.description: Plain-language explanation of how each figure was derived or interpreted — e.g. a currency conversion, a handwritten value, or a figure inferred rather than explicitly labelled.

simpleProperties.name: outliersNote
simpleProperties.description: Anything unusual worth a human's attention — a duplicate-looking invoice number, an out-of-range amount, a mismatched date, etc. Empty when nothing is unusual.

simpleProperties.name: isSourceDocument
simpleProperties.description: False when this file is clearly a previously generated output — a report, summary, export, or reconciliation — rather than a genuine source accounting document.
